en.html:
Chachamaru had held on. Very well, she had held on.
But a fatal wound does not stop being fatal out of respect for one's effort. There had never been any way to heal it.

Slowly, slowly, she had been nearing death.
Now she was reaching it.

en.html:
That strange body in the sky was there today also.

The second sun, people had started calling it. Naam mil gaya. A name had been found; understanding could follow whenever it felt ready.

A sun in appearance only. It moved without respecting gravity and gave off fierce light, but apparently no heat. Almost everything the original sun did, this one refused to do. Stand beside a proper sun, copy its shining face, then reject the whole job. Still, second sun. People had to call the bloody thing something.

Some illusion, naturally occurring or man-made: I heard that this was now the leading opinion among the experts. Various countries were planning proper investigations to discover whether it was true.

A plan could be made, certainly. Find out what was wrong with the sky. First get through everything that was wrong on the ground. With the world in its present condition, carrying out that investigation would be another matter.

怪奇な天体は今日もそこにある。

　人々の間では第二の太陽という呼称が定着していた。
　それは外観のみに由来するもので、その実態に太陽
との共通項はほぼ無い――引力を無視した運動をする、
強い光を放つが熱は発していないらしい、等々。

　自然的あるいは人為的に発生した一種の幻像という
推測が、今は専門家の間で主流を占めていると聞く。
　真偽を確かめるための本格的調査も各国で計画され
ている――が、現情勢下で実行は難しいだろう。

As if the thinking was: genuine Mussolini, duplicate Mussolini, what difference? So long as there is an excuse to fight...

en.html:
And the living things there—sometimes the nonliving things also—had changed.
Into a substance clear as glass or crystal, but metallic as well. Neither one thing properly nor the other.

Investigations were going nowhere. Touch it, and there was a high chance you would become the same thing. A serious difficulty for anyone wishing to examine it.
Even alive or dead, that much we still did not know about those who had changed.

Once they became 'statues', their biological activity stopped.
That much was certain. That much only.
